lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgMn5O10 (Mg2Mn10O20) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Mg centers with six O neighbors in an octahedral motif, while Mn adopts both octahedral and four-coordinate O environments. Oxygen centers are octahedrally coordinated by varying Mg and Mn neighbor counts. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates edge-sharing between Mn octahedra and both corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and Mn octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
